criteria_preregistered.text:
# Pre-registered decision criteria (rules-decision, written before any variant or ride number was seen)

Configurations: BASE = shipped defaults (both flags 0). C1 = cluster.floating_long_min_length=3.0.
B = cluster.short_signature_max_length=3.0 + cluster.short_signature_max_distance=100.0. B+C1 = both.
All runs: scripts/regression_gate.py --cache /data/cache --jobs 3, native path, receive stamps,
ride in the gate's default 8 pieces, set F straight = the gate's round-3 parameters.

1. Baseline: measure BASE with the ride. Record ride frames / alarm frames / events / STOP episodes /
   events per km (13.0 km) and set F straight per kind (person, box1.0, box0.5, trolley, cable):
   detected of 6, median first-confirmation distance, median held-from (sustained) distance.
2. Variants C1, B, B+C1 each with --baseline BASE.
3. C1 is GO iff ALL of:
   a. ride: events(C1) <= events(BASE) AND STOP episodes(C1) <= BASE AND alarm frames(C1) <= BASE;
   b. set F straight, per kind: detected(C1) >= detected(BASE) (no object lost), AND
      median first confirmation(C1) >= BASE - 2 m, AND median held-from(C1) >= BASE - 2 m
      (a missing value where BASE has one counts as lost);
   c. set O identical: every set_O.* metric of the gate (per-object STOP frames, first STOP,
      held-from, advisory frames, false STOP frames, background frames / ids, totals) equal;
   d. doubleT_obstacle identical: every recordings.doubleT_obstacle.* metric of the gate equal.
   Otherwise C1 is NO-GO.
4. Let X = C1 if C1 is GO, else BASE. X+B is (B+C1) or B accordingly. B is GO iff ALL of:
   a. ride: events(X+B) - events(X) <= max(5, 10 % of events(X)) AND
      STOP episodes(X+B) - STOP episodes(X) <= 5;
   b. set F straight not worse than X, same tolerance as 3b (per kind: detected not lower, median
      first confirmation and median held-from not lower by more than 2 m);
   c. organizers' objects gain holds: set O inside STOP frames(X+B) - inside STOP frames(X) >= +40.
   (A large ride cost is excluded by 4a: > +5 events on 13 km would be one new false event per
   ~2.6 km or worse.) Otherwise B is NO-GO.
5. Latency: information only. Six-bag / five-bag rows: information for the decision (they were
   already known), reported in the tables.
Tie-breaks: none; criteria are applied literally. "C1 = 3.0" (not 4.0) is the candidate value
because 3.0 and 4.0 were identical on the six recordings; 4.0 is not measured here.
